youtube_description:
My name is Lola (Lost On Land Again).  I am a van dweller in training and this is my story.

Vicky VanGo, her kitty cat Roo and I went to Cedar Creek Park for the weekend.  It looks like summer in N. Texas has officially begun. The boat dock was humming!

Life is all about the journey, not the destination. I hope you enjoy my videos! Stay Lost my friends!

My Outro was made by FVM

I found this music over on HTop's channel.
